See It Installed

Watch how fast a modular ramp goes together.

Access4U's Enable modular ramping system is engineered for a quick, single-person installation — the H-frame locks in a solid, stable run while quick height-adjustment points and one-size hardware do the rest. No 'cut-to-fit' parts and no special crew required.

  • One-person installation with only one wrench size
  • H-frame system creates a solid, seamless run
  • Quick height-adjustment points adapt to any site
  • No cut-to-fit parts — assembles and relocates easily

Why Access4U

Why Access4U belongs in a DME dealer’s access program.

Access4U gives dealers a protected, Made-in-U.S.A. access line with inclusive pricing, fast lead times, and installation built for one person — the kind of facts that turn a quote into a sale.

Your margins are protected

Access4U never sells through online retailers or superstores. The product is available only through authorized dealers — protecting your pricing and your local territory.

100% Made in America

All-aluminum, welded construction with more than 98% U.S.-sourced materials, a 1,000 lb residential ramp capacity, and a rust-free maintenance-free design.

Inclusive, quote-friendly pricing

Pricing is all-in — a 5-ft ramp includes legs, feet, hardware, and entrance and exit plates. No 'cut-to-fit' parts and no surprise add-ons when you quote a job.

Fast 7–10 day lead times

Typical lead times are 7 to 10 business days or less, shipped from Charlotte, NC via UPS, ODFL, XPO, AAA Cooper, and R&L — so you can close and install quickly.

One-person installation

The signature H-frame makes a solid, stable system, with quick height-adjustment points, handrail panels, and only one wrench size needed — engineered for single-person installs.

Real quoting and service support

A quoting team with 25,000+ quotes of experience helps you size every project, a 16+ year FSS government contract adds credibility, and when you call, they answer.

From a quick threshold fix to a complete home access project.

Access4U helps dealers serve multiple access needs instead of sending customers elsewhere. Start with a threshold or portable ramp, then support larger residential and commercial modular layouts when the customer needs a full solution.

Suggested dealer product strategy

Use this structure to present Access4U as both a retail add-on line and a larger project-based accessibility solution.

CategoryDealer use caseKey talking pointBest next step
Threshold ramps Doorway transitions, single steps, garage entries, and quick needs. Simple, practical cash-sale solution for small rises. Stock common sizes and train staff to ask about rise height.
Portable folding ramps Temporary access, travel, loading, or customer-owned mobility equipment. Foldable, transportable, and easy to demonstrate in the showroom. Display one unit and create a simple sizing guide.
Assist ramps Short exterior transitions where handrails add safety and confidence. More stability than basic portable ramps, without a full modular layout. Promote for porches, tiered sidewalks, and garage entries.
Residential modular ramps Permanent or semi-permanent home access projects. Customizable layouts with ramp runs, platforms, handrails, and accessories. Offer site evaluations and project quote requests.
Commercial ramps Public access, facilities, churches, clinics, and government-related opportunities. Designed for ADA/IBC-oriented applications and heavier-duty needs. Build referral relationships with contractors and facility managers.
